A '''master-at-arms''' was the [[army/Legends|military]] or [[Navy/Legends|naval]] rank held by the individual who was responsible for discipline and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] among the [[troop/Legends|troops]] or on a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. 

The [[Unidentified chief pilot (Barderia)|chief pilot]] was the master-at-arms for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Barderia]]''.
